name: Title on Image Card
description: A square photo with only a title on it, over a gradient. The whole card is one link: its title link covers it. Its colors don't change on hover, because the photo covers the card: the photo zooms, and the title is underlined.
sources: az-digital/arizona-bootstrap#2365 (design-reviewed): the square image, the title's blue gradient over its bottom half, and the title's 24px padding
Arizona Bootstrap 5.2: the title's 30px line height (.h5)

root.description: The card: a photo, with the title on it. It has no fill of its own, because the photo covers it.

border.width.$description: Card border width: none, since the fill sets the card apart from the page. In a forced colors (high contrast) mode, which removes fills, draw a 1px border instead so the card keeps its edge.

border.radius.$description: Card corner radius. An image takes the card's top corners, and stays inside them when it zooms.

image.description: The photo, which fills the whole card, cropped to a square if it has to be. It zooms in on hover and with keyboard focus, inside the card's corners.

aspect-ratio.width.$description: Photo shape: its width, against aspect-ratio.height. The photo is square.

aspect-ratio.height.$description: Photo shape: its height, against aspect-ratio.width. The photo is square.

transition.duration.$description: How long the image takes to zoom in, and back out. Turned off when someone asks for reduced motion; the image still zooms.

transition.easing.$description: Easing for the image zoom: ease. Turned off when someone asks for reduced motion.

scale.$description: How much the image grows on hover: 8% larger. Implementations use it as transform: scale().
How much the image grows while keyboard focus is on the card's link: the same as on hover.

title.description: The title, a link that covers the whole card, at the bottom of the photo. Behind it, a gradient covers the bottom half of the photo, from transparent at the top of that half to gradient.color at the bottom, so its White text stays readable on any photo.

line-height.$description: Card title line height. The space below the title is measured from this line.

height.$description: How much of the photo the title's gradient covers, as a percentage of its height: the bottom half. Implementations use calc(var(--…) * 1%).

padding.x.$description: Space between the photo's left and right edges and the title: the same as a card's padding.

padding.bottom.$description: Space between the photo's bottom edge and the title: the same as a card's padding.
